messages:
marta: quick heads-up — I want to run a small canary for quant-profile-v2 later today, ~03:00 UTC. low-risk slice, 10 slots, 15m window. who can own roll/rollback? :eyes:

josh: I can take owner for the window if no objections. i'll be oncall 02:50–04:00 UTC. what's the smoke checklist?

marta: thanks. smoke checklist: 1) 95th latency check on /generate (target < 300ms) 2) token-cost delta sanity 3) a handful of golden prompts against pinned model 4) KV cache hit rates not dropping >5% 5) no OOMs in logs.

anika: pinging the perf-runner job — i'll run golden prompt evals and post diffs. can you drop the command you want me to use for toggling profile?

marta: use the slot toggle script: 
```
./infra/deploy_toggle.sh --slot=12 --model=redwood-13B --profile=quant-profile-v2 --duration=15m
```
also add --dry-run for rehearsal.

sean: quick Q: is this a kernel bump too or just quant param changes? impacts rollback route.

marta: quant param only — no kernel change. rollback is revert profile to quant-profile-v1 via same toggle script.

josh: noted. i'll watch logs and latency dashboard. anika — share the golden diff within 5m of canary start so we can decide to continue.

anika: will do. i'll run the eval at T+2m and post results. if regressions > 2% quality we'll abort.

ci-bot: Scheduled canary: slot=12 window=03:00–03:15 UTC, owner=josh. Test hooks: perf-check, golden-eval, kv-monitor.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed for slot 12: container image sha ok, infra health ok.

josh: small ops note — to speed rollback, i've prepared this one-liner to flip back and rewarm cache: 
```
./infra/deploy_toggle.sh --slot=12 --model=redwood-13B --profile=quant-profile-v1 && ./infra/cache_warm.sh --slot=12 --model=redwood-13B
```

marta: perfect. also FYI i'll be ready to approve canary-extension up to 45m if metrics look stable. else we keep 15m. :thumbsup:

anika: golden evals ready, posting the diff now: +0.3% avg token perplexity, no busted completions in the sample set. attaching quick paste: 
```
prompt1: baseline 12.3 -> quantv2 12.4
prompt2: baseline 10.8 -> quantv2 10.7
```

josh: looks good. starting canary in 2m. i'll drop updates here every 5m and call abort if any red flags.

marta: cheers. small ask — if you see KV-hit drop, notify infra-sre channel and i'll slash to rollback. otherwise we'll follow the prepared rollback one-liner.

sean: oncall aware and monitoring traces. i'll take a look at tail of /var/log/serving/*.log if any error spikes.

josh: canary started. perf dashboard: p95=285ms, token cost delta -1.2%. KV hit diff: -0.4%. golden eval posted above. continuing.

anika: golden eval T+5m: still within thresholds. no new failures.

josh: T+10m: p95=290ms, no OOMs, cpu/gpu util nominal. extending to full 15m complete window.

marta: great — if 15m completes clean we'll schedule a gradual ramp to 30% traffic tomorrow morning. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
